environment.description: Actix-web service deployed on a bare EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2023, t3.medium) behind an NLB (Network Load Balancer) with TCP passthrough on port 443. No application-layer filtering. SQLite database file stored on local EBS volume. Service runs as ec2-user with direct network exposure through the NLB. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0.

config.database: SQLite on local EBS, no query filtering
